title: Augmented James--Stein estimation for leading eigenvectors and eigenspaces in high dimensions
summary: Building on the James--Stein approach to leading eigenvector estimation (Goldberg and Kercheval, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 120, e2207046120, 2023), we develop a data-adaptive augmented James--Stein shrinkage framework for estimating leading eigenvectors and eigenspaces under a generalized spiked population model, in the high-dimensional regime where the dimension $p$ and sample size $n$ grow proportionally.
